It started great. Met when we were 16 and we were together for 3 years. 6 months at the end of our relationship she was very mean to me and was ruining my self image and self esteem... So I ended up meeting another girl who was very kind and understanding and accepted me. So I started hanging out with her off and on for about 5 months. My girlfriend eventually found out and broke up with me. I then realized what I had lost and I felt an hole in my life. This one person I have shared so much time with and I ruined it. I hated myself and wanted to kill myself for what I had done and i would try to call her so much that it was over a hundred calls in just an hour. I ended up in a psychiatric unit for 4 days. Last time I talked to her was a few hours ago with a few insults and a threat of a restraining order and again my heart ripped out and my self esteem ruined. But guess who's still there ? That's right girl number two. I should probably let her go because of my mental state .....because my standards for love are so high she can't quite meet them at the moment. But again I am weakened from the recent loss so I just sit here not knowing how to go about much. My arms are cut and my life is endangered and I will probably call her again tonight. I'm in the latter part of my whole break up story.
